messages:
Noah: Heads-up: proposing a controlled unpin of runtime -> 2.18.0 during the 01:00 UTC change window for the 'llama-mini-surges' canary. Posting risk list and rollout gates here.

Ivy: What changed in 2.18.0? Any ABI or streaming contract differences?

Noah: Main changes: small-batch streaming refactor (improves throughput for batch>16 but regresses sub-batch latency), updated kv eviction heuristics, and a fix for a corner-case allocator leak. No ABI changes.

Ops-Mike: Does the kv eviction tweak change guaranteed response ordering for prefix-cached sessions? That was a gotcha last quarter.

Noah: It preserves ordering but changes eviction timing; workloads relying on precise cache lifetime may see more cache misses early on. We'll enable a KV-grace flag during the canary to extend TTLs.

Sara: Rollout suggestion: 1) 1% for 15m smoke 2) 5% for 30m 3) 20% for 45m 4) 100%. Telemetry triggers: error rate >0.6% over 5m, p99 latency +80ms vs baseline, or sustained cache miss increase >30% for 10m.

DeployBot: Plan scheduled: action=soft-unpin runtime=2.18.0 model_group=llama-mini-surges window=2026-03-24T01:00:00Z traffic_ramp=[1,5,20,100] rollback_triggers=["err>0.6%","p99>80ms","kvmiss>30%10m"] runbook=/runbooks/unpin-2-18-canary.md

Ivy: SDK check: python-sdk v5 OK, go-sdk v2 shows a marshaling warning on streaming chunks. I'll patch go-sdk and post a compatibility note.

Noah: Good. Also preflight: run ./scripts/pin-scan --type runtime --from 2.17.0 --to 2.18.0. Need to know if any customers will be affected by forced routing changes.

DeployBot: Pin-scan complete: 4 customer agents with explicit runtime pin (two agent-v1, two agent-v2). Created SE tasks and sent emails.

Ops-Mike: For those customers, can we apply a soft-hold so they stay on 2.17 during the window? We should avoid surprise behavior for paid seats.

DeployBot: Soft-hold applied to matching pinsets for window=2026-03-24T01:00:00Z. SEs notified.

Sara: Who takes rollback pager if auto-rollback fires? Ops-Mike plus oncall-sre. Also, we should pause any scheduled load-tests during the ramp.

Ops-Mike: Confirmed. I'll mute internal load-tests for the window and set pager rotation.

Docs-Jules: I'll add a short note in release notes: "runtime 2.18.0: streaming refactor; potential sub-batch latency increase; kv eviction timing changed" and include ops rollback criteria.

Ivy: One more: some internal dedicated clients use a runtime pin override in /etc/redwood/agent.conf. I'll push a one-line update to the agent package to warn on boot if pinned to <2.18.0 and enable automatic reco.

Noah: Thanks. Final decision at 00:30 UTC after the preflight checks. If no red flags, proceed with the staged ramp. Tagging this thread 'action:canary-unpin-2-18' and will update once preflight finishes.
